title: "RV3008: Server-only code referenced by browser code"

**Severity:** error · **Area:** Imports / helpers / route modules (`RV3xxx`) · **Quick fix:** none

## Message

The diagnostic reads one of:

```text
`{name}` is server-only (removed from browser builds) but browser code references it at line {line}
```

```text
`{name}` (from "{source}") is used by browser code at line {line}; server-only modules cannot reach the browser — use it only inside server exports
```

Parts in braces (`{name}`) are filled in for each report.

## How to fix

Use server exports and server-only imports only inside server exports; pass their results to the page as serverLoad data instead.

## Example

```tsx avoid nocheck
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export const serverLoad = () => 1;
export default () => <p>{String(readFileSync)}</p>;
```

```tsx prefer
import { readFileSync } from "node:fs";
export const serverLoad = () => readFileSync("a.txt", "utf8");
export default () => <p />;
```

## When it is reported

First variant lacks a fix hint.
